events.title: Winter Hunt
events.summary: Typhoeus Chartered Headhunting; opens after the Dreamscape of Wind and Snow version release.

events.title: Deep Cold Issue
events.summary: Umbra of Frigid Eventide weapon rate-up; ends after three Chartered Headhunting banners starting with Winter Hunt (news 4480). The official version notes list them as Winter Hunt (5208), then Rejuvenation and The Hearth Fire Beckons the Starry Flow (9560); the last ran until the Nov 25 version maintenance, which began at 22:00 UTC (0740).

events.title: Monumental Etching: Shadow Marked
events.summary: Limited reward window for the permanent Umbral Monument stage series Marked by Dark Shadows; closes at the October 19 server reset.

events.title: Resplendent Spectrum
events.summary: Yvonne RE-Factor Headhunting #1; September 24 at 12:00 server time until before the next version update and maintenance (news 5208). That maintenance began Oct 15 at 06:00 UTC+8 (Asia) and Oct 14 at 17:00 UTC−5 (Americas/Europe), the same instant (news 9560). The cross-region start is shown at day precision.

events.title: Echoes of War: Season of Phantasia — Cycle I
events.summary: Official internal cycle deadline at 03:59 server time (Asia UTC+8; Americas/Europe UTC−5). Cycle II opens at 04:00 server time, one minute later; the season continues. Start is a calendar-day anchor, not an exact regional opening.

events.title: Echoes of War: Season of Phantasia — Cycle II
events.summary: Official internal cycle deadline at 03:59 server time (Asia UTC+8; Americas/Europe UTC−5). Cycle III opens at 04:00 server time, one minute later; the season continues. Start is a calendar-day anchor, not an exact regional opening.

events.title: Echoes of War: Season of Fervor — Cycle I
events.summary: Internal cycle deadline at 03:59 server time (Asia UTC+8; Americas/Europe UTC−5), from the wiki season's cycle table. Official notes (Sanctuary of Ink, news 9560) confirm the season opens Nov 5 12:00 server time with 3 cycles; the Phantasia cycle table on the same wiki matched the official schedule to the minute. Cycle II opens at 04:00 server time; the season continues. Start is a calendar-day anchor, not an exact regional opening.

events.title: Echoes of War: Season of Fervor — Cycle II
events.summary: Internal cycle deadline at 03:59 server time (Asia UTC+8; Americas/Europe UTC−5), from the wiki season's cycle table. Official notes (Sanctuary of Ink, news 9560) confirm the season opens Nov 5 12:00 server time with 3 cycles; the Phantasia cycle table on the same wiki matched the official schedule to the minute. Cycle III opens at 04:00 server time; the season continues. Start is a calendar-day anchor, not an exact regional opening.

events.title: Echoes of War: Season of Scattering — Cycle I
events.summary: Internal cycle deadline at 03:59 server time (Asia UTC+8; Americas/Europe UTC−5). Official notes (news 0740) give 3 cycles and a season end of Dec 16 11:59 server time; cycles follow the weekly 04:00 pattern of earlier seasons, and an in-game timer on Nov 25 matched this deadline. The wiki's cycle table is a day early. Cycle II opens at 04:00 server time; the season continues. Start is a calendar-day anchor, not an exact regional opening.

events.title: Echoes of War: Season of Scattering — Cycle II
events.summary: Internal cycle deadline at 03:59 server time (Asia UTC+8; Americas/Europe UTC−5). Official notes (news 0740) give 3 cycles and a season end of Dec 16 11:59 server time; cycles follow the weekly 04:00 pattern of earlier seasons, and Cycle I's deadline matched the in-game timer. The wiki's cycle table is a day early. Cycle III opens at 04:00 server time; the season continues. Start is a calendar-day anchor, not an exact regional opening.

events.title: Monumental Etching: Forest of Maras
events.summary: Limited reward window for the permanent Murmurs of the Deep Forest stages. Official Sanctuary of Ink notice closes this event November 5 at 04:00 server time: Asia UTC+8, Americas/Europe UTC-5.

events.title: Rejuvenation
events.summary: Si Chartered Headhunting. Opens after the Sanctuary of Ink update; closes November 5 at 11:59 server time (Asia UTC+8; Americas/Europe UTC-5).

events.title: Seal of Jade Issue
events.summary: Jade Vessel Arsenal Issue. Opens after the Sanctuary of Ink update and ends after three Chartered Headhunting banners starting with Rejuvenation (news 9560): Rejuvenation, The Hearth Fire Beckons the Starry Flow, and Anvil, Backpack, Plus A Pot o'Honey, which closes Dec 23 at 11:59 server time (Asia UTC+8; Americas/Europe UTC−5; news 0740).

events.title: Ancestral Spring Flows Anew
events.summary: Tangtang RE-Factor Headhunting #1. October 29 at 12:00 to November 19 at 11:59 server time; opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

events.title: Tender Sprig Issue
events.summary: Brigand's Calling RE-Factor Issue #1. Separate weapon channel, October 29 at 12:00 to November 19 at 11:59 server time; opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

events.title: The Hearth Fire Beckons the Starry Flow

November 5 at 12:00 server time until before the next version update and maintenance (news 9560), which began Nov 25 at 06:00 UTC+8 (Asia) and Nov 24 at 17:00 UTC−5 (Americas/Europe), the same instant (news 0740). Opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

events.title: Moongleam Issue

events.summary: Sweet Deal Arsenal Issue. Opens after the Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms update and ends after three Chartered Headhunting banners starting with Anvil, Backpack, Plus A Pot o'Honey (news 0740); no calendar cutoff is announced. Opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

events.title: To Every Wish Adrift

events.title: Floaty Traveler Issue

events.title: Precious Scarlet

events.title: Scarlet Claws Issue

events.title: Contingency Readiness
events.summary: Complete daily missions for limited-time supplies. October 29 at 04:00 to November 5 at 04:00 server time (Asia UTC+8; Americas/Europe UTC-5); opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

events.title: Echoes of War: Season of Fervor
events.summary: Seasonal reward window starts November 5 at 12:00 server time and ends before the next version update and maintenance (news 9560). That maintenance began Nov 25 at 06:00 UTC+8 (Asia) and Nov 24 at 17:00 UTC−5 (Americas/Europe), the same instant (news 0740). The permanent Echoes of War mode remains available. Opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

events.title: Season of Scattering
events.summary: Echoes of War season. Official notes (news 0740) run it from the version update to Dec 16, 2026 at 11:59 server time (Asia UTC+8; Americas/Europe UTC−5), with 3 cycles. This overrides the earlier end (Dec 15) on the wiki's Event page; an in-game timer on Nov 25 matched the official end. The permanent Echoes of War mode remains available. Opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

events.title: The Stars Are With Me
events.summary: Sign in for a total of 7 days to earn The Stars Are With Me HH Permit x5. Starts November 5 at 12:00 server time; ends before the next version update and maintenance (news 9560). That maintenance began Nov 25 at 06:00 UTC+8 (Asia) and Nov 24 at 17:00 UTC−5 (Americas/Europe), the same instant (news 0740). Opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

events.title: Contingency Contract: Indigo Experimental Operation
events.summary: Challenge and mission reward window starts November 5 at 12:00 server time; content updates November 12 at 12:00 server time. Ends before the next version update and maintenance (news 9560). That maintenance began Nov 25 at 06:00 UTC+8 (Asia) and Nov 24 at 17:00 UTC−5 (Americas/Europe), the same instant (news 0740). The separate Secret Sanctuary exchange has its own December 2 cutoff. Opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

events.title: Secret Sanctuary
events.summary: Exchange earned Vitrified Indigo for event rewards from November 5 at 12:00 through December 2 at 04:00 server time (Asia UTC+8; Americas/Europe UTC-5). This exchange deadline is separate from the Contingency Contract challenge period and does not establish its end. Opening is shown as a calendar day across regions.

events.title: Sanity Supply — November 2026
events.summary: Complete daily missions for Sanity Supply rewards. Starts November 18 at 04:00 server time; Asia ends November 25 at 04:00 (UTC+8), while Americas/Europe ends November 24 at 17:00 (UTC-5). Opening is shown as a calendar day across regions; the western closing clock is an explicit exception.
